title: Earthy Crisp Tunisian Baby Lettuce Salad
description: A refreshing monsoon Tunisian dish featuring baby lettuce leaves, ferment-jang, and dairy-free ingredients, with a focus on umami and crisp textures. This salad is perfect for a light and satisfying lunch.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the baby lettuce leaves and chopped dates.
In a small bowl, whisk together the ferment-jang, olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the lettuce mixture and toss to combine.
Sprinkle the chopped almonds over the top of the salad and toss again to combine.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the salad a good toss to redistribute the ingredients.
Serve the salad chilled, garnished with additional chopped almonds if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
